# Release Notes - v1.18.0 ## Feature ### Tallyhall - Receipt preview in mobile approval notifications Approvers on a phone could see the total of an expense but not the receipt, so many waited until they were back at a laptop. The approval notification now shows the receipt image right in the approval notification, with the merchant, date, and policy checks underneath, and Approve / Reject work without opening the app. The preview is a **downscaled copy of the stored receipt, not a new upload**: the original image is kept untouched for audit, and the preview is generated once when the expense is submitted. Approval history and exports are unchanged. ## Fixes ### Tallyhall / Tallyhall Mobile - Approval push notifications no longer fail for some devices Some approvers stopped receiving push notifications because one expired device token in their account made the whole send fail, so no device got the message. Delivery now skips expired tokens and still reaches every active device. Also fixes the Tallyhall Mobile settings screen wrongly showing "Notifications on" for users whose only registered device had been removed. ## Technical details
Receipt preview rendering - Previews are rendered at submit time to a 640px WebP next to the original in object storage; the notification payload carries a signed URL that expires after 24 hours. - The approval action buttons call the existing approve/reject endpoints with the notification's one-time token, so no new permissions are introduced. - Older expenses without a preview fall back to the previous text-only notification.
Push delivery - skip expired device tokens - Tokens the push provider reports as expired are marked inactive at send time instead of failing the batch, covering approvals, reminders, and policy alerts. - The Tallyhall Mobile settings screen now reads the active-device count directly (fixes the false "Notifications on").
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/tallyhall/app/compare/v1.17.8...v1.18.0
